fields.summary: Brand Manager: Confirm Visibility to Deal and Deal Rep Assignment Records

issuetype.description: A task that needs to be done.
issuetype.name: Task

fields.description:
Outcome and context

BUILD-202 (BA-1, WAGR-176) already added a required Brand Manager lookup on the BA record — a BA without a Brand Manager is excluded from roll-up reporting — but the Brand Manager side of that relationship was never built out. Emily's Sep 2026 feedback raises the open question directly: what object or record holds a Brand Manager, and how does it get created? The intent is an out-of-the-box object with sharing controls (viewability) rather than a fully custom build.

Current state

Brand Manager exists today only as a lookup field on BA (BUILD-202), pointing at an object/record type that has not been defined. No Brand Manager object, record type, or creation process exists yet, and no sharing rules have been scoped for it.

Proposed solution

  1. Decide the object Brand Manager records live on — most likely a standard object (User or Contact) used out-of-the-box rather than a new custom object, per Emily's note.

  2. Define how a Brand Manager record gets created (manually, alongside BA setup, or another process).

  3. Scope the sharing model/visibility rules for Brand Manager users — the specific Deal/DRA visibility question is covered in a related ticket (see Out of scope); this ticket covers the object and record-creation piece.

Acceptance criteria

  1. The object/record type Brand Manager uses is decided and documented.

  2. A repeatable process exists for creating a new Brand Manager record.

  3. Baseline sharing controls (who can view a Brand Manager record and its role) are defined.

Out of scope

The specific visibility Brand Managers get into Deal and Deal Rep Assignment records — tracked separately in "Brand Manager: Confirm Visibility to Deal and Deal Rep Assignment Records."

Dependencies

Depends on BUILD-202 — Brand Ambassador: Object + Core Status (WAGR-176), which added the Brand Manager lookup on BA.

Source

Wagertech Notes / Questions (Emily Vandenberg), reviewed Sep 2026: "Brand Manager / out of the box, with sharing controls (viewability) — Object / Record for Brand Manager (how does this get created)." https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ShxHdE6kxblGnih7VQzXbBx1eL0sC6XAD-fk8H6V9yw/edit?tab=t.0
